none: PAS NLM-16D3F5: Early Medieval Coin: Styca of Eanred of Northumbria
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Styca of Eanred of Northumbria (c.830). Obverse description: Central cross, with initial cross ?pattee. Obverse inscription: +EANRED REX. Reverse description: Central rosette of six pellets around a central pellet, with further radial lines; initial cross ?pattee.. Reverse inscription: +[?EADWUL?]F. Diameter: 12.3mm, Weight: 0.95gms
